rationale: This study conducts a purely qualitative thematic and comparative analysis (using NVivo and Lucidchart Venn synthesis) of Community Ownership and Management (COM), Public Utility, and Consultative (Hybrid) water governance models in three Upper West Region districts of Ghana based on semi-structured key informant interviews, focus group discussions, document review, and field observations. No statistical models, hypothesis tests, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values are estimated anywhere in the paper (only secondary background figures such as historical CWSA coverage percentages and tariff rates are cited in prose), and Section 2.6 explicitly notes the study's reliance on qualitative data and calls for future quantitative assessments.
